_about: Starts on the road outside a settlement (rules/openings.py; docs/design-c-starts.md 4.5; the owner's answer Q24, 2026-09-28: the caravan attack and the road-in are the first road set). The envelope is core.json's.

where.at = road stands the party at one of the settlement's road heads, 'the road to X' where a route the world wrote leaves it (Lane B's ring, rules/outskirts.py), drawn from the story seed; a settlement with no road out cannot host one. The town is ahead of them, never around them.

The owner's own example, 2026-09-28: 'walking toward a town and as i crest a hill i see a caravan under attack. this on the road scenario would be the best start and its simple.' The caravan hand draws it six times as often as anyone else (fits.backgrounds).

The caravan's attackers are what the ground holds (fight from: land): the bestiary by the road head's own biome and a CR window around the party, spent against the Core Rulebook's XP budget for an average encounter at the party's level; bandits from the codex where the book stocks nothing for that ground. $raiders in the edge is filled with what the engine staged ('two wolves'), because a document cannot know what the land will send.
The drovers are the caravan's own people: on the board, in no side, bystanders the fight is round.

starts.name: The caravan on the road
starts.doing: You are walking beside the second wagon with a hand on the traces.
starts.edge: The lead wagon has stopped dead across the road, with $raiders coming at it off the open ground ahead.

lead.label: the wagon master
lead.look: standing up on the box and shouting
lead.says: Get the wagons round, all of you. Nobody runs, and nobody leaves a wagon.

hand_off.moment: The nearest attacker comes at the wagon you are walking beside.

starts.errand: You came on this road with the wagons, for the pay at the far end of it.
suggestions: Put myself between the attackers and the wagon
Get the wagon master down off the box

starts.name: The road in
starts.doing: You are walking the last stretch of the road, with the first roofs in sight ahead.
starts.edge: A cart has lost a wheel in the ruts and the carter is trying to lift it alone.

lead.label: the carter
lead.look: red in the face under the cart's tail
lead.says: Would you. It will not come up for one, and nobody else has stopped.

hand_off.moment: The carter lets the cart down and straightens up, waiting on you.

starts.errand: You came on foot because the road ended here, with a purse about a week from empty.
suggestions: Ask what the place ahead is like
